title: Cryptography, secrets, signing
status: AUTHORED. The domain where a wrong assumption is silent, so every entry pairs with a control.

atom_notes.A09: a property the design assumes is true is not, and nothing visibly fails when that happens
atom_notes.A08: secrets are exposure, and secret discovery is an information problem before it is a crypto problem
atom_notes.A05: an encoding or padding difference that one layer checks and another does not
atom_notes.A03: tokens are identity, so token crypto is identity crypto

required_cells.why: identify what the crypto is supposed to guarantee before testing it
token and secret testing needs automation with rate awareness
forgery or cracking is the exploitation step
a token that parses is not a token that is accepted
retest after key rotation or algorithm pinning

entries.name: jwt_tool
entries.role: The full JWT attack set, plus claim tampering
entries.note: Start with -M at to run everything, then narrow. Hand crafting a claim before that wastes time.

entries.name: hashcat
entries.role: Offline cracking for hashes recovered from artefacts
oracle: plaintext or a verifiable progress rate

entries.name: John the Ripper (jumbo)
entries.role: The counterpart, better on some formats and on rule based attacks

entries.name: CyberChef
entries.role: Decode and transform chains, the fastest way to identify an unknown encoding
preconditions: a blob of unknown encoded data
oracle: a readable result and the recipe that produced it
entries.note: Recipe export is the useful part: it makes the decode reproducible instead of a screenshot.

entries.name: PadBuster
entries.role: Padding oracle exploitation for CBC ciphers
preconditions: an oracle that distinguishes padding errors
oracle: decrypted plaintext or a forged ciphertext

entries.name: gitleaks
entries.role: Fast regex secret scan across repos and bundles

entries.name: trufflehog
entries.role: Verified secret detection, which cuts noise to near zero
entries.note: --only-verified is the flag that makes this usable. Everything else is a candidate list.

entries.name: rea analyze_web_bundle
entries.role: Find the signing function in the bundle, which is the only way to replay a signed request
oracle: the signing function and its inputs located in recovered source
entries.note: Request signing lives in client code by definition. If the app signs, the algorithm is in the bundle.

entries.name: PayloadsAllTheThings
entries.role: JWT, hash and crypto payload corpus

entries.name: jwt.io
entries.role: Decode and inspect a token quickly. Never paste a production token
entries.note: Client side tool. Pasting a live token into a website is a disclosure, and it happens constantly.

tree.q: Is the weakness in a token, a secret, or a cipher?
tree.why: Three different disciplines that share a domain name. Token attacks are about validation. Secret attacks are about exposure. Cipher attacks are about mathematics and oracles.

branches.action: decode, then test validation: none, algorithm confusion, key confusion, claims. acceptance is the only oracle
branches.oracle: server accepts a token it should reject

branches.action: scan with verification on. an unverified candidate list is noise
branches.oracle: secret verified live against its service

branches.action: find the oracle first. without a distinguishable error there is no attack
branches.oracle: padding oracle distinguishes the two error classes

branches.action: the algorithm is in the client. recover it, then decide whether the key is client side
branches.oracle: a replayed signature accepted with a modified body

branches.action: identify the type, then choose a wordlist and rule set. never guess the type

mirror.detect: alg in the token does not match the configured algorithm
key material in a bundle or APK
mirror.control: no secrets client side, rotate on discovery
mirror.rule: secret pattern in a served asset

mirror.detect: repeated IV or nonce per key
mirror.control: random or counter nonce with uniqueness proof

gaps.gap: No tool that lifts a signing function from a bundle and proves the replay
gaps.build_candidate: locate the function, wrap it, sign a modified body, and diff against a control request

gaps.gap: No secret scanner that reports where the secret is USED, only that it exists
gaps.build_candidate: join the finding with the call site so the impact is stated not guessed
replay the proving token request after key rotation
